title: docs(qa): shell-nav-personalization judges the Pinned section's order; the authored menu is not user-reorderable (objectui 8a55f0ccda)
body:
Fixes #22487
Clause-②: no

Rewrites one checklist item, `platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, to the sidebar behaviour that landed in **objectui `8a55f0ccda`** (`8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521`, objectstack-ai/objectui#12066, objectstack-ai/objectui#12059). It moves to `revision: 2` and gains a `history` entry. No other item or file changes. The console pin bump that carries that commit (#22476) can cite this PR.

## Authority

- The maintainer, verbatim (card body): 「右侧浏览器，左侧菜单在用户界面不应该显示拖动按钮，拖动设计是studio的工作。」
- Scope note on the card: personal ordering survives only inside the sidebar's **Pinned** section, and the authored menu order is not user-reorderable.
- Triage's direction on the card: step 3 and acceptance[2] are **replaced**, not only removed. The negative half: the authored menu draws no grip and keeps the app's authored order whatever per-user key is stored. The positive half: a pinned entry reorders by dragging the row and by keyboard, and the order persists across reload. The positive clause is desktop-only, because a phone draws no Pinned section.

## What the code at `8a55f0ccda` does (read from source, not from the PR summary)

objectui `main` is `8a55f0ccda` itself at this writing, so there is no drift between the landing and the tip. All links below are pinned to that sha.

- **The authored menu has no reorder.** `UnifiedSidebar` no longer has `useNavOrder`: it existed at the parent `c7b30bd6` and is gone at `8a55f0ccda`. The comment at [UnifiedSidebar.tsx L169-L173](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx#L169-L173) states the stored key is not read. `enableReorder` / `onReorder` are retired at [NavigationRenderer.tsx L229-L233](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L229-L233). Menu levels are only sorted by `byNavOrder` ([L1732](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1732); [navOrder.ts L39](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/navOrder.ts#L39): `order` ascending, with ties in array order).
- **The app arm wires the Pinned section's order**, in [UnifiedSidebar.tsx L531-L534](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx#L531-L534): `enablePinning={!isMobile}`, `pinnedOrder={pinnedIds}`, `onPinnedReorder={reorderPins}`.
- **The Pinned section is `PinnedNavigationList`** ([L1192](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1192)):
  - It has its own `DndContext id="nav-pinned"` ([L1223](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1223)).
  - A pointer press becomes a drag after 5px ([L1137](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1137)).
  - The keyboard codes are start `Space`, cancel `Escape`, end `Space`, and not Enter ([L1145-L1148](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1145-L1148)).
  - The row's own link is the activator: `dragActivatorProps` applies only `aria-describedby`, never dnd-kit's `role`, `tabIndex` or `aria-roledescription` ([L1258-L1267](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1258-L1267)). The link also gets `cursor-grab` ([L1605](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1605)).
  - The insertion line is `data-drop-indicator` ([L1325](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1325)), and the section is ordered by `orderPinnedItems` ([L1859](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1859)).
  - Its heading is `console.nav.favorites` ([L1758](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#L1758)). That reads 'Favorites' in en and 「收藏」 in zh, not "Pinned".
- **The value of `aria-describedby` is `nav-pinned`.** In `@dnd-kit/core` 6.3.1 (the version objectui's lockfile resolves), `useUniqueId("DndDescribedBy", id)` returns the given `id` unchanged, so a pinned link's `aria-describedby` is the `DndContext` id.
- **Persistence.** `useNavPins.reorderPins` → `FavoritesProvider.reorderNavPins` ([useNavPins.ts L145-L156](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavPins.ts#L145-L156); [FavoritesProvider.tsx L496](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/app-shell/src/context/FavoritesProvider.tsx#L496)).
  - `withNavPinOrder` ([L182](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/app-shell/src/context/FavoritesProvider.tsx#L182)) reorders the `type: 'nav'` favorites in place.
  - `withAddedFavorite` ([L167](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/app-shell/src/context/FavoritesProvider.tsx#L167)) appends a new nav pin.
  - `commit` ([L407](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/app-shell/src/context/FavoritesProvider.tsx#L407)) writes localStorage plus the adapter. In the console, that adapter is the `sys_user_preference` row keyed `ui.favorites` ([ConsoleShell.tsx L329](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx#L329)).
- **Phone.** `isMobile` means a viewport under 768px ([use-mobile.tsx L11-L22](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/8a55f0ccdafa0b58e09f5d188641834f7da31521/packages/components/src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx#L11-L22)), and there `enablePinning` is false, so no Pinned section is drawn.

## Each changed text (before → after)

Placeholders that the file spells in angle brackets appear here as `NAVID` / `APP` / `APP_NAME`, because GitHub's body sanitizer eats angle-bracket fragments. The file's own spelling is unchanged.

1. **`title`**
   - Before: "Shell nav personalization: sidebar collapse, pin/reorder, favorites, recents and header breadcrumbs each persist and stay navigable across reload"
   - After: "Shell nav personalization: sidebar collapse, pins and the user's pinned order, favorites, recents and header breadcrumbs each persist and stay navigable across reload; the authored menu keeps the app's order"
   - Read from: triage's "drop 'reorder' from the title"; UnifiedSidebar L169-L173.
2. **`revision`**
   - Before: 1. After: 2.
   - A `history` entry is appended (item 13), per the README's "Change" rule and the validator's revision = last-history check.
3. **`fixtures.requires[0]`**
   - Before: "…something to pin, reorder, favorite, and visit as recents"
   - After: "…something to pin — at least three entries, so the pinned order can change — favorite, and visit as recents"
4. **`fixtures.requires[1]`** (new)
   - After: "a desktop viewport, at least 768px wide, for the Pinned section: below it useIsMobile is true and UnifiedSidebar passes enablePinning={!isMobile}, so a phone draws no Pinned section and has no pinned order to judge"
   - Read from: use-mobile.tsx L11-L22; UnifiedSidebar L531.
5. **`steps[2]`**
   - Before: "drag-reorder: reorder nav items by drag (UnifiedSidebar useNavOrder, enableReorder / onReorder=handleReorder); reload — the order persists (localStorage per-app key)"
   - After: a "pinned order (desktop only)" step. It names:
     - where the section is: above the menu, headed `console.nav.favorites`, not the content-favorites group below Recent;
     - the pointer drag: the row itself, no grip, `cursor-grab`, 5px activation, `data-drop-indicator`;
     - the keyboard path: Space / arrows / Space, Escape cancels, Enter follows the link;
     - persistence: `onPinnedReorder → useNavPins.reorderPins → FavoritesProvider reorderNavPins`, the order of the `type 'nav'` favorites;
     - the order rules: a new pin joins the end, an unpin leaves the order.
   - Read from: NavigationRenderer L1137, L1145-L1148, L1192, L1258-L1267, L1325, L1605, L1758; useNavPins L145-L156; FavoritesProvider L167, L182, L496.
6. **`steps[6]`** (new; "authored menu (any viewport)")
   - After: the menu has no grip, no `aria-roledescription="sortable"`, no `aria-describedby="nav-pinned"` and no `cursor-grab`, and dragging a menu row moves nothing. Its order is the authored order (`byNavOrder`).
   - It then plants the retired key `objectui-nav-order-APP_NAME` (a JSON map of `__root__` and each group id to reversed id lists, the shape the retired `useNavOrder` read) and reloads: the order is unchanged.
   - Read from: NavigationRenderer L229-L233, L1732; navOrder.ts L39; UnifiedSidebar L172; the parent's `useNavOrder` at `c7b30bd6` UnifiedSidebar.tsx L143-L212.
7. **`steps[7]`** (the persistence step)
   - Before: "…pins/favorites/recents are UserDataAdapter-backed (cross-device sync), reorder + collapse are local (localStorage / cookie)"
   - After: "…pins and their order, favorites and recents are UserDataAdapter-backed (cross-device sync; pins, their order and favorites are one sys_user_preference row, key ui.favorites), collapse is local (cookie sidebar_state)"
   - Read from: ConsoleShell L329; FavoritesProvider L407.
8. **`acceptance[2]`**
   - Before: "drag-reorder persists: the reordered nav order is restored after reload (useNavOrder localStorage)", verified as "the nav item order before reload equals the order after reload".
   - After: "pinned order (desktop): a pinned entry is reordered by dragging its row and by keyboard (Space, arrows, Space), and the Pinned section's order is restored after reload (the order of the nav:NAVID favorites …)".
   - Its `verify` drives:
     - one pointer drag, with intermediate moves past 5px;
     - one keyboard move;
     - an Escape control;
     - a reload;
     - a control that each pinned link does carry `aria-describedby="nav-pinned"` and `cursor-grab`.
   - Oracle `dom`.
9. **`acceptance[6]`** (new, appended so favorites, recents and breadcrumbs keep indexes 3-5)
   - After: "the authored menu is not user-reorderable (any viewport): no row outside the Pinned section draws a drag grip or carries aria-roledescription=\"sortable\", aria-describedby=\"nav-pinned\" or cursor-grab, and the menu renders in the app's authored order even with a stored objectui-nav-order-APP_NAME key".
   - Its `verify`:
     - counts zero `[aria-roledescription="sortable"]`;
     - checks the menu links, with the pinned-row control;
     - compares the authored and rendered order;
     - plants the reversed key, reloads and re-reads;
     - repeats the probe at a phone viewport.
   - Oracle `dom`.
   - Read from: the same lines as item 6. The landed pin `NavigationRenderer.pinnedOrder-12059.test.tsx` asserts the same discriminators (zero sortable role, no `aria-describedby` / `cursor-grab` on menu links).
10. **`negative`**
    - Before: "a pin / favorite / reorder / recent that does NOT survive reload is a FAIL of its persistence contract"
    - After: "a pin, the pinned order, a favorite or a recent that does NOT survive reload is a FAIL of its persistence contract"
    - Two lines are added:
      - On the authored menu, a grip, a sortable role, the drag instructions, a grab cursor, a drag that moves a row, or a non-authored order (with or without the stored key) is a FAIL.
      - A phone draws no Pinned section, so its absence there is not a FAIL of the pinned order.
11. **`traps`**
    - Before: `hydration-race`, `shared-browser-tab`.
    - After: adds `stale-console-bundle` and `automation-input`, both already in RUNNER.md's trap table.
    - `stale-console-bundle`: this repo's `.objectui-sha` is still `f0268ad784`, which predates `8a55f0ccda`. A console built at that pin still draws the menu grip, and a run against it must recognise that rather than file a regression.
    - `automation-input`: a one-jump synthetic pointer move never crosses the 5px activation distance, and reads as a dead drag.
12. **`source`**
    - The UnifiedSidebar line is re-pointed. Before: "(useNavOrder drag-reorder localStorage; Recent section; applyPins)". After: no menu reorder; the stored key is not read; `enablePinning={!isMobile}` / `pinnedOrder` / `onPinnedReorder`; Recent section; applyPins.
    - The useNavPins and FavoritesProvider lines gain `pinnedIds` order / `reorderPins` and `reorderNavPins` / `withNavPinOrder` / `withAddedFavorite`.
    - New: objectui `NavigationRenderer.tsx`, `navOrder.ts`, `use-mobile.tsx` and `ConsoleShell.tsx` (bare: sibling-repo citations stay bare per the README).
    - New: one local anchor, `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-preference.object.ts#sys_user_preference`, which resolves (anchors 719/729 → 720/730).
13. **`history`**: an entry is appended, `{ revision: 2, date: 2026-10-09, ref: #22487 }`. It quotes the ruling verbatim and names `8a55f0ccda`.

Unchanged: the collapse, pin/unpin, favorites, recents and breadcrumbs steps and clauses, and the screenshot-first negative.

## Acceptance notes

- **NOT MEASURED: a live run of this item against a console built at `8a55f0ccda`.** The clauses are written from the code above. objectstack-ai/objectui#12066 records its own Chromium readings (0 grips, 0 `aria-roledescription` at rest, a pinned link with `cursor: grab`, the keyboard path, a pointer reorder without navigation). The next `checklist-test` run of this item is the measurement.
- **The Pinned section's heading reads "Favorites", the same word as the content-favorites group below Recent.** The pinned heading is `console.nav.favorites`; the content group is `sidebar.favorites`. Both are 'Favorites' in en and 「收藏」 in zh. The item said "the Pinned section" for a heading no user sees by that name. The new step names the heading, and the pin/unpin step's wording is left as it was (out of scope). Whether two same-named groups confuse users is a static reading only, not reproduced in a running console, so it is not filed. Carrier: none.
- **acceptance[1] (pin/unpin) is equally desktop-only in the code**, since `enablePinning={!isMobile}` also hides the pin buttons. Its text is unchanged by the dispatch scope. The new fixture line (a desktop viewport) covers it in practice. Carrier: none.
- **Ordering.** Triage set that this lands no later than the console pin bump carrying `8a55f0ccda` (#22476). Until that bump, a console built at `f0268ad784` fails acceptance[6], which is what the added `stale-console-bundle` trap tells a runner.
